answer: Randomized Witness Slotting assigns each agent an epoch slot by a public verifiable random function over the epoch beacon, so an attacker cannot precompute which identities will be sampled to corroborate a transaction. Every sampled slot must echo a signed receipt within the round; missed slots slash a fixed copper deposit. Sybil clusters gain nothing, since slot luck is unpredictable, and each extra identity costs a fresh deposit plus atlas-backed storage of its key history.
